title: Yummy Irish Apple Grill
description: A sweet, flaky, cozy Irish apple dish glazed with shoyu‑koji and paired with spherified apple spheres, all cooked on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium heat and oil the grates lightly with coconut oil.
Core the apples, cut them into thick slices, and place them on a parchment sheet.
Whisk together shoyu‑koji, maple syrup, sea salt, black pepper, and lime juice in a small bowl to make a glaze.
Brush the glaze over both sides of each apple slice.
Grill the apple slices for 4 minutes per side until caramelized and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, blend oat flour and coconut oil with a splash of water to create a thick dough for spherification.
Drop small spoonfuls of the mixture into a cold 1% sodium alginate bath to form spheres, then rinse and set aside.
Roll the vegan puff pastry into thin rounds, place a slice of grilled apple in the center, and fold over to form a flaky parcel.
Place the pastry parcels back on the grill for 3 minutes until golden brown and puffed.
Serve the grilled apple slices and pastry parcels with the spherified apple spheres floating on top, dusted with cinnamon.
